# powerhmc_sys_config (Data Source)

Retrieves configuration information for an IBM Power HMC managed system.

Use this data source to look up an existing managed system and read its firmware, power, and memory configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Query the current configuration and state of a managed system.
data "powerhmc_sys_config" "server" {
  name = "existing-server-name"
}

output "system_uuid" {
  value = data.powerhmc_sys_config.server.uuid
}

output "system_state" {
  value = data.powerhmc_sys_config.server.state
}

output "system_model" {
  value = data.powerhmc_sys_config.server.machine_type_model
}

output "firmware_version" {
  value = data.powerhmc_sys_config.server.firmware_version
}

output "power_saving_mode" {
  value = data.powerhmc_sys_config.server.power_saving_mode
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the managed system as it appears in HMC. Used to look up the system on every read.

### Read-Only

- `firmware_version` (String) Firmware version of the managed system.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the managed system.
- `machine_type_model` (String) Machine type and model in format `XXXX-YYY` (e.g., `9009-22A`).
- `mem_mirroring_mode` (String) Memory mirroring mode for the managed system. Possible values: `none`, `system firmware only`.
- `mem_region_size` (Number) Indicates the size of the memory blocks that can be assigned to partitions. Any changes that you make will be applied after the next system restart.
- `power_off_policy` (Boolean) Automatically power off system when all LPARs shut down.
- `power_on_lpar_start_policy` (String) Partition start policy controls automatic LPAR startup behavior. Possible values: `autorecovery`, `autostart`, `userinit`.
- `power_saving_mode` (String) Power saving mode for the managed system. Supported values vary by system generation (Power 9/10/11).
- `reference_code` (String) Reference code of the managed system.
- `requested_huge_pages` (Number) The number of pages of huge page memory that is requested by the managed system.
- `state` (String) Current state of the managed system (e.g., `operating`, `power off`).
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the managed system.
